We report two sets of metrics here: (1) Language and (2) Parse metrics. Language metrics (MAUVE and word overlap) are measured from the generated utterances themselves, whereas parse metrics (chi-square distance and function overlap) are measured from parse trees corresponding to the synthesized utterances.
